learnings.title: Shopify developer changelog feed: Checkout MCP and Cart MCP now support UCP buyer consent
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog (feed item and page checkout-mcp-and-cart-mcp-now-support-ucp-buyer-consent, published 16 Oct 2026, read 2026-10-17) states Checkout MCP and Cart MCP support the UCP buyer consent extension dev.ucp.shopping.buyer_consent from UCP 2026-08-25: agents that negotiate it get a buyer.consent object (analytics, preferences, sale_or_sharing, marketing with email/sms segments) and can send buyer choices on cart/checkout create, update or complete; without sent consent Shopify applies the shop's country defaults (opt-out if country unknown), and a missing_consent_data warning blocks checkout until the contact detail is provided. Integrations that do not declare the extension or use an earlier UCP version are not affected.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: only relevant if video_shopify builds an agent checkout on Checkout MCP or Cart MCP with UCP 2026-08-25; then declare dev.ucp.shopping.buyer_consent, show the shop's consent options and handle missing_consent_data. No operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Search video_shopify code and connector configs for Checkout MCP/Cart MCP or UCP usage; record found/not-found before 2026-10-24.
